issue.title: Writing to a FileRegion to the AioSocketChannel may throw a StackOverflowError

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
Writing to a FileRegion to the AioSocketChannel may throw a StackOverflowError because we not reuse our AioCompletionHandler there to guard from it.
